comments.text:
OPEN-02 FINDINGS (Gemini Pro, 2026-07-11):
Step-1 offline mechanism: DROP STEP 1. Winget default source is now a REST API (cdn.winget.microsoft.com/cache); 'winget show/search' trigger network (violates promptgate Rule 6) and no longer expose a full local offline manifest cache. Also 'winget show/export' do not even output UninstallerSwitches.
Recommended chain: corrections.json (was step 2) becomes PRIMARY source of truth, then heuristic fallback (/qn -> /S -> --silent -> -quiet). No winget dependency.
Seed list for corrections.json (app -> silentArgs, source):
- Google Chrome: --uninstall --multi-install --chrome --system-level --force-uninstall (Chrome Enterprise / setup.exe)
- Mozilla Firefox: /S against helper.exe (Firefox enterprise docs)
- Slack: --uninstall -s (Squirrel.Windows)
- Zoom: /uninstall /silent (Zoom bulk deploy guide)
- Steam: /S (NSIS)
- Notepad++: /S (NSIS)
- VLC: /S (NSIS)
Confidence 9/10; residual risk = custom EXE installers not seeded fall through to heuristic, unavoidable offline.
IMPLICATION: contradicts promptgate Rule 15 (winget = step 1). Deviation needed BEFORE TASK-10 coding: amend Rule 15 + 04-schema ENT-03/00-prd REQ-10 to a 2-step chain, log in DEVIATIONS.md.

comments.author: QuantumMonkey
comments.text:
OPEN-01 FINDINGS (Gemini Pro, 2026-07-11):
Recommended mechanism: NtSuspendProcess/NtResumeProcess (ntdll), process tree discovery via Get-CimInstance Win32_Process.
Why: undocumented but the exact API Sysinternals Process Explorer uses; stable across Win10/11; atomic kernel-level whole-process suspension. Documented SuspendThread+Toolhelp32 alternative has a TOCTOU race (threads spawn during enumeration).
Code sketch: scratch/NtSuspendProcess-Sketch.ps1 (Antigravity scratch - NOT merged; Sonnet reimplements per spec gate).
Failure modes: Access Denied on protected/higher-priv processes (mitigated: Vanish runs elevated); PID reuse during discovery (mitigated: hold handles open after discovery).
Resume guarantee: C# class implements IDisposable storing opened handles; PS wraps in try/finally { $suspender.Dispose() } so resume+handle-close always runs.
Confidence 9/10; residual risk = MS deprecating the ntdll export (improbable - would break debuggers/anti-cheat/security tooling).
